product: Commercial crude oil; excludes strategic reserves

covid_exclusion.method: Exclude targets and direct lag inputs touching COVID from stock fitting; exclude COVID observations from flow fits and seasonal averages; preserve the full calendar and historical balance.
covid_exclusion.evaluation: Exclude COVID target months from development selection; full recursive development years avoid COVID; final 24 months unchanged.

equation: S[t] = S[t-1] + days[t] * (field production[t] + imports[t] + net receipts[t] + adjustments[t] + transfers to crude[t] - refinery input[t] - exports[t] - direct use[t] + residual[t])
cv: 10 expanding folds, 12 eligible test months each; final 24 months excluded from selection
forecast_timing: One month after latest observed EIA month; conditional on prior monthly data being available. Current revised history, not a real-time release-vintage backtest.
selection: GridSearchCV per PADD/model on development data; PADD winners plus common model families; lowest national development MAE chooses the one-month model; no holdout tuning

hyperparameter_search.splitter: TimeSeriesSplit on non-COVID target dates; 12 eligible observations per development block; default block size inside recursive origins
hyperparameter_search.evaluation: Development scores reuse tuning folds and are selection scores, not nested CV estimates. Final 24 months excluded from all searches.
hyperparameter_search.recursive: Each development origin retunes on its past history. Holdout and final refits freeze parameters selected before holdout.

horizon_selection: Lowest national MAE across six disjoint 12-month development paths, six full non-COVID development years; all 17 candidates compared
flow_forecast: Last 60 non-COVID observations, daily rates, linear trend and month fixed effects; crude run = forecast utilization ratio (clipped 0–1) times CDU capacity fixed at origin
uncertainty: Point forecasts only; no calibrated prediction intervals
recursive_validation: 13 overlapping 12-month paths entirely in final holdout; refit at each origin; correlated errors
